name: MediaSpark
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
MediaSpark simplifies WordPress media management with intuitive organization and analytics tools. Key features include:

  • Media Folders: Organize attachments hierarchically.
  • Media Tags: Add non-hierarchical tags for easy searching.
  • Auto Alt Text/Tags: Optionally generate alt text and tags from the first two words of the file title (max 2 words).
  • Analytics: Filter used (attached) and unused (unattached) images in the media library.
  • Multilingual Support: Fully translated into English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Japanese, with community translation support via WordPress.org.

Upgrade to MediaSpark Pro for advanced features like watermarking, WooCommerce product category matching, lazy loading, image compression, and bulk editing.

Lightweight, secure, and built to WordPress standards.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mediaspark folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu.
  3. Configure options in Settings > MediaSpark.
  4. View analytics in Media > Media Analytics.
sections.faq:
Does MediaSpark create physical folders?

No, it uses virtual taxonomies for efficient organization.

How are used/unused images detected?

Used images are attached to posts/pages (post_parent != 0). Unused are unattached. Pro offers more advanced detection.

Is the plugin translatable?

Yes, MediaSpark is translation-ready and includes translations for English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Japanese. Additional translations can be contributed via translate.wordpress.org.
